create_reading_order_visualizer: create a ReadingOrderVisualizer to visualize document reading order with numbered arrows on page images
build_reading_order_params: build ReadingOrderVisualizer.Params with custom show_label, show_branch_numbering, and content_layers settings
get_visualization_doc: get visualization of a DoclingDocument's reading order as per-page PIL images with red arrows showing element sequence
draw_arrow_coordinates: draw a red arrow between two coordinate points on a PIL ImageDraw object with custom line width and color
draw_doc_reading_order: draw reading order arrows across all pages of a DoclingDocument using element bounding box centers
